question: Does autonomous paper verification continue beyond 25 AI turns without changing evidence or the existing paper resource authorization?
criteria: New intake stores a null turn ceiling and retains the exact initial request
Actual PostgreSQL admission accepts numbered turns beyond 25, including invalid responses, while retaining positive cost reservations and fenced leases
The cumulative counter and owner-scoped paginated history work beyond turn 25
A historical cap stop resumes its retained stage at turn 26 without resetting prior prompts, responses, findings, commitments or deadline
Budget/deadline/cancelled/completed/external-blocker and uncertain-provider cases do not resume through the count-limit recovery gate
Original requests replay across the policy change only when their sole change is the removed count ceiling; changed source or scope is rejected
Current trusted controller policy supersedes immutable legacy prompt references to 25 turns and is stored in each actual request
Browser writes and private-history reads remain denied at SQL; anonymous and cross-owner routes remain protected
Desktop/mobile and light/dark queue views show cumulative counts without a turn ceiling and explain invalid/unavailable status
methods: Exposed synthetic software cases against actual local SQL, worker and UI. Forty sequential admission records check the former boundary; this is a deterministic regression count, not a scientific sample-size claim. Historical guard publication uses an explicitly synthetic fixture and its frozen original release profile. No new prompt or model candidate is published.
controls: Retain legacy 25-turn admission denial before upgrade; compare full old turn records and immutable initial hashes after upgrade. Preserve failed checks and timestamped reports. Actual paper budget and deadline gates remain independent of count.
exclusions: Frozen prior pilot protocols/results and historical model-evaluation policies keep their original attempt ceilings. No historical pilot replay or renewed paper budget/deadline is implied.
conditional_gaps: Actual live model behavior with the amended controller policy
The earlier subscription pilot remains stopped under its original frozen protocol; a separately versioned continuation is required
